projection_policy.summary: Control-plane does not own the Figma top-level coverage SSOT. It only projects the coverage entries that require HTTP/SSE/OpenAPI/generated-client behavior.
projection_policy.top_down: When contracts coverage adds or changes required generated paths, update the control-plane API DSL/OpenAPI/generated client and this projection gate together.
projection_policy.bottom_up: When control-plane implementation discovers a path, cache, stream, or endpoint contradiction, fix local projection if the meaning is local; escalate to contracts if Figma coverage or business policy is wrong.
